sources.observation: Preference item 18 round-trips reducesound through the application preference record. Closing always plays button sound 141, so Reduced Sound does not mute ordinary action feedback.
The spell-name editor rewrites application STR# resources through SetIndString; it is unavailable when the scenario-owned names resource is active.
The Race/Caste editor rewrites application STR# 129 or 131 directly. These are application resource mutations, not gameplay-save state or scenario-authored definitions.
Reduced Sound gates the Items opening ambience 20001 and item-detail ambience 30005 while item actions keep their independently requested sounds.
Reduced Sound gates Cast Spell opening ambience 20002.
Reduced Sound gates Swap opening ambience 3003 after channels are quieted; transfer sounds 10051 and 663 and Done sound 141 remain outside the gate.

decision.observation: Realmz Rebuilt persists Reduced Sound and suppresses only explicitly eligible presentation events. It never globally filters a numeric sound ID because the same resource can occur in an ungated action context. Custom name editing is intentionally omitted: compiled stock/scenario definition strings remain immutable package facts and stable display identities, so a host preference cannot rewrite them.
decision.consequence: The correction preserves deterministic gameplay and package identity while retaining Castle's player-visible modal-sound choice. Custom names remain a visual-only omission that cannot block import, navigation, targeting, or gameplay.

expectedTrace: load Reduced Sound from host presentation settings with a false migration default
mark each implemented Castle-gated opening event explicitly
suppress an eligible event before stopping channels or resolving media
retain ungated action, transfer, completion, and scenario-authored sounds
persist the host preference outside the gameplay save
keep package definitions and their display strings immutable
